name: toolkit
description: Status line (account | effort | context | 5h and weekly usage), a usage guard that warns Claude before a limit is hit, per-turn effort skills, project rules for subagents, optional automatic agent use and a per-task context budget

effortRules.title: Effort rules
effortRules.description: Tell Claude to pick its effort per turn with the effort skills and name it in every reply

usageLine.title: Usage line for Claude
usageLine.description: Start each main turn with one line of the status line's numbers for Claude (account, effort, context, 5h and weekly usage)

guard.title: Usage guard
guard.description: Warn Claude at the wrap-up and stop thresholds

agentNotes.title: Agent notes
agentNotes.description: Also send running subagents their own short notes

narrowAgents.title: One agent toward the limit
narrowAgents.description: With two or more agents running, tell Claude from the wrap-up stage on (or earlier when usage rises fast) to keep one agent going and stop the others

narrowMinutes.title: Lead time for one agent (minutes)
narrowMinutes.description: Tell Claude to keep only one agent once the stop stage is due within this many minutes at the current rate

usagePoll.title: Usage refresh (seconds)
usagePoll.description: Fetch the account's usage this often while Claude or an agent works (every 5 minutes when idle), so the status line and the guard also see other sessions and quiet stretches; 0 turns it off

handoffFile.title: Handoff file
handoffFile.description: Create a handoff file at the first warning in a session

agentRules.title: Project agent rules
agentRules.description: Add the project's .claude/agent-rules.md to every new subagent's prompt

agentUse.title: Start agents on its own
agentUse.description: Tell Claude to start subagents without being asked when parallel work makes sense

contextBudget.title: Default context budget
contextBudget.description: The default context budget until Claude sets one for the task (100000 to 1000000): at 90 % of it Claude must decide (raise it, or hand off and compact); 0 turns the context budget off

contextCap.title: Context budget cap
contextCap.description: The largest budget Claude may set on its own; above it only when you ask

handoffFolder.title: Handoff folder
handoffFolder.description: Where handoff files go inside a project, relative to the project root (or absolute)

outsideProjectFolder.title: Handoff folder outside a project
outsideProjectFolder.description: Where handoff files go for tasks outside a project, relative to the Claude config folder (or absolute)

fiveHourWrapUp.title: 5-hour wrap-up %
fiveHourWrapUp.description: 5-hour usage at which Claude wraps up

weeklyWrapUp.title: Weekly wrap-up %
weeklyWrapUp.description: Weekly usage at which Claude wraps up

weeklyStop.title: Weekly stop %
weeklyStop.description: Weekly usage at which Claude stops

extraNote.title: Extra note
extraNote.description: Text appended to every guard note (optional)
